items.title: Pay electricity advance payment (Abschlag)
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den fälligen Abschlag von 214,00 € bis spätestens 11.09.2026.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for payment: 11.09.2026. This is only 2 business days after the letter's own date (07.09.2026, a Monday) and falls on a Friday, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed. No statutory delivery-fiction period applies since this is a private company, not an authority. Note: this deadline and the payment instructions are very likely fraudulent (see warnings) and should not be acted upon without independent verification.

warnings: Strong signs of a phishing/scam letter: it demands an urgent payment to a newly-announced bank account within days, under threat of an immediate, unannounced power cut-off.
The new IBAN's own check digits do not validate (failed the standard German IBAN checksum check), meaning the IBAN as printed is not even a technically valid account number.

The stated account holder 'Global Energy Payments s.r.o.' does not match the sender 'Stadtwerke Musterstadt' and uses a foreign (Czech/Slovak) company form — utilities do not route SEPA collections through unrelated foreign intermediaries.

The letter tells the recipient not to reply by post and to call only a mobile 'Sondernummer' instead of the utility's normal customer service line, and the reply e-mail domain (kundenservice-mail.example) does not look like an official Stadtwerke domain — both are classic tactics to prevent verification.

Do not transfer any money to the IBAN given in this letter; verify the demand by contacting Stadtwerke Musterstadt directly using contact details from a previous bill or their official website, and consider reporting the letter as attempted fraud (Verbraucherzentrale / police).
